task.title: Install SMS device to a motor without cooling ribs
task.shortdesc: This section describes the process of installing an to a motor without cooling ribs.

context.p: This section describes the process of installing an to a motor without cooling ribs.
Prerequisite: You need a specially designed magnetic base.

fig.title: Installing an on a motor without cooling ribs

context.p: To install an to a motor without cooling ribs:

step.cmd: Follow steps 1 and 2 of the previous section to verify that the batteries are installed in the .
Attach and screw the magnetic base to the base of the .
Place the in the back-center area, as shown in the diagram on the SMS case.

info.note: Follow these indications regardless of whether the motor is in a vertical or horizontal position. For more information on the proper positioning of an , see Dos and don’ts .

step.cmd: Use a marker to mark the position where the magnetic base will be placed.
Use the sandpaper to sand the surface where the will be fitted to remove the paint. Preparing the surface will improve adhesion.

info.p: Caution: Wear gloves while handling sandpaper to avoid skin irritation. Use sandpaper gently to avoid damaging the cooling fins' surface.
PPE Required: Wear gloves before preparing the adhesive. Mix the bi-component adhesive using the mixing tool.

step.cmd: Apply the adhesive generously to the magnetic base.

info.note: The adhesive is required in addition to the magnetic base.

step.cmd: Fix the device using the magnetic base to the motor.
On the , confirm that the is installed by tapping Confirm sensor is mounted to begin the learning process.
